taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems 10-25 (to 50) dm, erect to sprawling, the outer branches arching.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems to 50 dm.

traits.stem_clump.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): arching shrubs, not rhizomatous: a clump of stems from the base, not a thicket.

traits.spine_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): prickles below the stipules paired, curved, 6-7 mm, all about one length; few between nodes.

traits.bark_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): bark green; sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets dark green to green above; sRGB by eye for the words.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves 6-11 cm.

traits.leaflets.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets 5-7.

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): terminal leaflet blade 15-40 mm long.

traits.leaflet_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): terminal leaflet blade 12-20 mm wide.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflet blades ovate, obovate or elliptic.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflet apex acute, sometimes acuminate.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflet margins singly or multiply serrate, 20-30 teeth a side.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): panicles, sometimes corymbs or single flowers, 2 or 3 (to 7) flowers; drawn as a corymb.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 1-3 (to 7) flowers.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: flower clusters 3 cm to 7 cm long; a cluster of one flower only as long as its stalk, from about 1 cm.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pedicels 8-20 mm.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers 3.5-5 cm across.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals 18-25 mm.

traits.sepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals 10-17 mm, deeply pinnatifid at the margins.

traits.sepal_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals appressed-reflexed, spreading or erect; reflexed in fruit.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals rose, pink or white; drawn pale pink, between them; sRGB by eye.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): carpels 26-36.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): hips 10-16 (to 24) mm long.

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): hips 6-16 mm wide.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): hips globose, ovoid, urceolate or ellipsoid; drawn ovoid.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): hips red; sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals fall as the hips ripen.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa canina (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowering May to July.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: hips red from September and kept into winter.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: an arching shrub of green stems with paired hooked prickles, pale pink single roses and oval red hips that drop their sepals.

allometry.note: 2.6 m tall at 12 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
